skill.name: tiktok获取搜索结果

searchKey.title: Search query
searchKey.description: Required keyword or hashtag. No sample query is inserted automatically.

count.title: Maximum results
count.description: Maximum number of results to return; up to 50.

maxPages.title: Maximum scrolls
maxPages.description: Maximum number of additional loads when more results are needed. Stops early when the target is reached.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: relevance keeps relevance order; other options sort by metrics available for each video.

initialWaitSeconds.title: Initial results wait (seconds)
initialWaitSeconds.description: Wait for TikTok search results and the first video cards to load.

pageWaitSeconds.title: Wait after each load (seconds)
pageWaitSeconds.description: Wait for the next batch of results to render. Increase this on slower networks.

saveResults.title: Save results to Tobub
saveResults.description: When disabled, results are still returned but are not written to the content library.

fields.label: Maximum results
fields.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

fields.label: Sort order
fields.description: Sort by relevance, recency, likes, or views.

fields.label: Maximum scrolls
fields.description: Loading limit when more results are needed.

fields.label: Initial results wait (seconds)
fields.description: Wait for the first search results to load.

fields.label: Wait after each load (seconds)
fields.description: Wait for the next batch of results to render.

fields.label: Save results to Tobub
fields.description: When disabled, return results without saving to Tobub.

metadata.description: 按关键词搜索 TikTok 视频，可配置结果数量、排序和加载等待；支持仅预览或保存到 Tobub。
